user.title: Connect this home to three.ws
user.description:
Open {connect_url}, add a home, and choose "my home is only on my network". three.ws shows a pairing code. Type it below within ten minutes.

This home will open one outgoing connection to three.ws. Nothing listens on your network, no port is forwarded, and three.ws never receives a Home Assistant token.

data_description.pairing_code: The code shown on three.ws. It works once and expires after ten minutes.
data_description.platform_url: Leave this alone unless you run your own three.ws.

error.invalid_code: That pairing code is not recognised. Check it on three.ws and try again.
error.code_used: That pairing code has already been used. Generate a new one on three.ws.
error.code_expired: That pairing code expired. Generate a new one on three.ws.
error.upgrade_required: This three.ws integration is too old for the relay. Update it in HACS and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Home Assistant could not reach three.ws. Check this machine's internet connection.
error.unknown: Pairing failed. Check the Home Assistant log for the reason.

abort.already_configured: This home is already connected to three.ws.
